note: Leaven (plan §6.19, owner's definition): a substance used to produce fermentation in dough, or a material used to produce a gas that lightens dough or batter, and ready-made foods that usually contain one. Checked in ingredient names and step text. Leaven is a badge and a filter, never the hard block. Fermented foods that aren't a raising agent (beer, soy sauce, vinegar, Worcestershire, miso) aren't leaven (owner, 2026-10-22). Plurals are matched too.
